concerns.text: US-01 scenario 2 ('Given the UCI Online Retail dataset structure... session clusters are extracted') has no covering task. The completed-work section lists a purely synthetic generator and the plan marks data/raw/ as '(Optional)', but no task fetches/checksums the UCI dataset or documents a justified narrowing of the scenario. An implementer following this tasks.md cannot satisfy US-01 scenario 2.

The data model declares data/derived/simulation_results_raw.csv, aggregated_metrics.csv, and config_snapshot.json as the result artifacts, but tasks produce baseline_results.csv, robustResults.csv, simulation_config_log.csv, and data/results/final_report.csv. No task reconciles the data-model filenames with the actual outputs, so the committed data model does not describe any file the tasks produce.

concerns.location: plan.md:Project Structure data/checksums.txt + Constitution III vs tasks.md:all phases
concerns.text: Plan and Constitution Principle III require checksummed data files (data/checksums.txt / state YAML artifact_hashes), but no remaining task produces or updates checksums for the new data/results/ and data/derived/ outputs generated in T103–T106. Coverage gap for the data-hygiene plan element.

T104(b) ICC=0 check is worded 'empirical error rate for standard_t at ICC 0 lies inside its Clopper-Pearson CI' — trivially true by construction (the CI is centered on the estimate), so the check cannot fail and provides no coverage evidence for the spec's ICC=0 edge case. Reword to test whether nominal alpha falls within the CI.
